_note: All simulator and truck assumptions. Every output of the simulator is SIMULATED, not observed. Values are stated assumptions, not measured operator practice.

scenario._note: Hourly Poisson rates = mean step-2 LightGBM prediction per station and local hour over Oct 2026 Mon-Fri, excluding US federal holidays (12 Oct). Predictions are read from forecast_predictions; the model is not refit or re-scored.

truck._operating_note: A move may start at the beginning of each local hour h with 6 <= h < 22.
truck._travel_note: Road km per hour available for driving: truck position -> source -> destination. Assumes ~24 min of driving at 15 km/h; the rest of the hour is loading/unloading. Straight-line distance is multiplied by road_circuity.
truck._target_note: Take bikes from the source down to target_fill*capacity and bring the destination up to target_fill*capacity, limited by truck capacity.
truck._gap_note: Only move when source fill minus destination fill is at least this.
truck._start_note: The truck starts the day at the first source station it picks (no initial deadhead).
